nameOrigin.title: Why the name Aljazari?
nameOrigin.body: We chose the name "Aljazari" in honor of the great scholar Ismail Aljazari, famously known as "Badi' alZaman." Aljazari was an exceptional scientist and engineer who lived in the 12th century, renowned for his remarkable contributions to engineering and robotics — introducing innovations ahead of their time, including mechanical devices and primitive robots that laid the foundation for modern technology.
nameOrigin.body2: At Aljazari, we draw inspiration from the genius and creativity of this great scholar, striving to embody his vision by offering modern technologies and innovative solutions for our contemporary era.

founders.title: Founders' Message
founders.p1: At Aljazari, we take pride in being pioneers in robot trade and maintenance, as well as artificial intelligence in Iraq. Our company was founded out of a deep passion for technology and a strong belief that continuous innovation and development are the keys to building a bright and sustainable future for our country.
founders.p2: We are a group of engineers and academics united by a common vision and a genuine desire to develop the field of robotics and AI in Iraq. We believe Iraq has immense potential to become a hub for technological advancement in the region.
founders.p3: Our message to you is our commitment to providing the best technical solutions and enhancing knowledge and skills in this field, to ensure a bright and sustainable future for our beloved Iraq. Together, we can make a difference and build a better future.

services.heading: Our Services
services.body: Aljazari provides robot sales, rental, and maintenance services, AI solutions, and training programs. All descriptions and prices are subject to change without prior notice.

orders.heading: Orders & Bookings
orders.body: Every order or booking is subject to confirmation by our team. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order for reasons including product unavailability or pricing errors.

warranty.body: Aljazari provides a 12-month warranty on all robots sold, covering manufacturing defects only. The warranty does not cover misuse or damage resulting from unauthorized intervention.

liability.body: Aljazari shall not be liable for any indirect or incidental damages resulting from the use of our products or services, to the extent permitted by law.

collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.body: We collect information such as name, email, and phone number when you register or contact us, along with basic usage data to improve your experience.

use.heading: How We Use Your Information
use.body: We use your information to respond to your inquiries, process your orders and bookings, and improve our services. We do not use your data for marketing purposes without your explicit consent.

share.heading: Sharing Information
share.body: We do not sell or rent your personal data to any third party. We may share limited information with service partners necessary to fulfill your order, such as shipping companies.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: Our website uses essential cookies to function properly, and optional analytical cookies to understand how visitors use the site.

security.heading: Data Security
security.body: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

rights.heading: Your Rights

tedxErbil.title: Aljazari at TEDx Erbil: The Next Wave
tedxErbil.excerpt: Aljazari took part in TEDxNishtiman in Erbil under the theme "The Next Wave." Founder and CEO Eng. Sinan Majeed spoke about Iraq's technological future and the role young people play in leading it.

itex2025.title: Aljazari Supports Smart Education at ITEX Iraq 2025
itex2025.excerpt: Aljazari joined ITEX Iraq 2025 alongside the Ministry of Education, bringing humanoid and educational robots that demonstrated the latest tools in smart classrooms.

visionIraq2050.title: Aljazari Robots at the Iraq Vision 2050 Conference
visionIraq2050.excerpt: At the Iraq Vision 2050 conference in Baghdad, Aljazari's robots ran live demonstrations showing how robotics can support education, hospitality, and smart public services.

mtuCollege.title: Aljazari Attends the Opening of the AI Engineering College at MTU
mtuCollege.excerpt: Aljazari joined the launch of the Technical Engineering College of AI at the Middle Technical University, reinforcing its support for academic partnerships in technology.

newSchoolYear.title: Joy and Innovation at the Start of the New School Year
newSchoolYear.excerpt: Aljazari spent a day with students from Cadmus School, JEEL Kindergarten, and Guardian Angel Kindergarten, where the children's excitement around the robots was a reminder that the future starts with small, curious steps.

youthSummit.title: Aljazari Supports the First Iraqi Youth Summit for Digital Empowerment
youthSummit.excerpt: Aljazari took part in IYS-25 in Baghdad to back AI and digital skills training, underlining that public-private partnership is key to building the generation shaping Iraq's future.

smartCitiesForum.title: Aljazari, Technical Sponsor of the Iraqi Smart Cities Forum 2025
smartCitiesForum.excerpt: Aljazari served as technical sponsor of the Iraqi Smart Cities Forum 2025 at Dijla Village, Baghdad, taking a new step with its partners toward smarter, more innovative cities.

engineersDay.title: Aljazari at the Iraqi Engineer's Day Celebration
engineersDay.excerpt: As part of Iraqi Engineer's Day at the Baghdad International Fair, Aljazari presented a showcase of robotics and AI technology that drew strong engagement from attending engineers.

albadoor.title: Aljazari Robots Feature at Al-Badoor Complex Sales Center Opening
albadoor.excerpt: Aljazari brought its interactive robots to the opening of the Al-Badoor Residential Complex Sales Center with Al-Ghadeer Real Estate, giving visitors a smart, engaging welcome.

aiSummitAnbar.title: Aljazari Joins the AI Summit in Anbar
aiSummitAnbar.excerpt: Aljazari took part in the Artificial Intelligence Summit at Al-Maarif University in Anbar, attended by senior officials and academics, reaffirming its support for Iraq's digital transformation.

beautyConnection.title: Aljazari Blends Beauty and Technology at Baghdad Beauty Connection
beautyConnection.excerpt: At Baghdad Beauty Connection, Aljazari's humanoid robots joined the "Tale of Beauty" pavilion with Nakheel Baghdad, offering a creative example of technology meeting the beauty industry.

digitizationForum.title: Iraq Enters the Era of Digital Transformation
digitizationForum.excerpt: Aljazari supported Iraq's First Digitization Forum in Baghdad, which brought together experts and decision-makers to explore new technologies and strengthen cross-sector collaboration.

energyExpo.title: Aljazari Sponsors the 10th Iraq International Energy Expo
energyExpo.excerpt: Aljazari proudly sponsored the 10th Iraq International Energy Expo & Conference, supporting the energy sector with robotics and smart solutions for greater efficiency and sustainability.

leapRiyadh.title: Aljazari Visits LEAP 2025, the Region's Largest AI and Robotics Event
leapRiyadh.excerpt: Aljazari joined LEAP2025 in Riyadh, a global tech platform where leading companies explored how robotics is transforming industries and showcased the latest research and innovation.

vexCompetition.title: Aljazari Joins Iraq's First VEX Robotics Competition
vexCompetition.excerpt: Aljazari took part in Iraq and Kurdistan's first national VEX Robotics competition, a qualifier for the World Championship in the US, supporting innovation among young people.

medico2025.title: Aljazari Takes Part in Medico 2025
medico2025.excerpt: Aljazari participated in Medico 2025, Iraq's largest international health exhibition in Erbil, showcasing robots built for the latest innovations in medical technology and AI.

roboticsClubs.title: Aljazari Joins the Launch of Robotics and AI Clubs in Iraq
roboticsClubs.excerpt: Aljazari took part in the launch of Iraq's Robotics and AI Clubs, held under the patronage of the Prime Minister and hosted by Al-Farabi University, alongside leading tech figures and institutions.

cuttingEdgeLaunch.title: Aljazari Introduces Cutting-Edge Robotics to Iraq
cuttingEdgeLaunch.excerpt: As Iraq's first officially registered robotics company, Aljazari brought humanoid, educational, and delivery robots to the market, shaping a future of efficiency and technological progress.

firstCompany.title: Iraq's First Officially Registered Robotics Company Launches
firstCompany.excerpt: Aljazari launched as Iraq's first registered robotics and AI company, offering smart solutions for delivery, reception, cleaning, industry, and education to bridge the country's technology gap.
